ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMACCOUNT] AS
BEGIN

WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)
, CustomerAccountBalance_LNS AS (
SELECT 

	MAX(Timestamp) AS Timestamp
	,CustomerAccountId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BalancetypeId
	FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
	WHERE BalancetypeId = 'Clear Balance Amount'
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, BalancetypeId
)
, FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)
, CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
    WHERE A.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
)
, CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL A
	JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT
AS (
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,* from ( 
    SELECT DISTINCT
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' ) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND (BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL OR BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
 

UNION ALL

--FOR TRU RECORDS FILTER
SELECT 
 BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,-1 AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT CA.CustomerAccountId,CA.CustomerAccountName,CA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CA.IsoCurrencyCode,CA.SourceSystemCode,CA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,CA.BRANCHID
FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY CustomerAccountName) AS RN, CustomerAccountId, CustomerAccountName, CustomerAccountOpenedDate, IsoCurrencyCode, SourceSystemCode, FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID, BRANCHID 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) CA
WHERE CA.RN = 1) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' ) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND (BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL OR BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
GROUP BY 
BCA.CustomerAccountId
,BCA.CustomerAccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID
,BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode
,DDB.BankSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId

UNION ALL

--FOR DEP RECORDS FILTER
SELECT
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
--,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate <= getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') 
     THEN 'Closed'
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN  BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     END AS AccountStatus 
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAF ON convert(varchar,BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' )
LEFT JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAF.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCACCT ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCACCT.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCACCT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCACCT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.DepositAccountStatus BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BDAS.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND BCAF.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')

UNION ALL

-- FOR LNS RECORDS FILTER
SELECT DISTINCT
	BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
	,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
	,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
	,CASE
		WHEN BCCA.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('LAA', 'CLA') AND BCAB.BalanceAmount = 0 
		THEN 'Closed' ELSE 'Active' END AS AccountStatus
	,CASE 
		 WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCAP.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
		 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
	,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
	,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
	,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
	,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,1 AS CurrentIndicator
	,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BCAB.* FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance BCAB
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountBalance_LNS BCABL ON BCAB.Timestamp = BCABL.Timestamp AND BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCABL.CustomerAccountId AND BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = BCABL.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAB.BalancetypeId = BCABL.BalancetypeId
WHERE BCAB.BalancetypeId = 'Clear Balance Amount' ) BCAB ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAB.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' )
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCAP ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCAP.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCAP.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCAP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID 
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'

) A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT;


WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountID
    ,AccountName
    ,AccountOpenedDate
    ,AccountStatus
    ,PayrollIndicator
    ,CurrencyCode
    ,ProfitCostCode
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountID
    ,AccountName
    ,AccountOpenedDate
    ,AccountStatus
    ,PayrollIndicator
    ,CurrencyCode
    ,ProfitCostCode
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN  TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR ( TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT SRC ON  SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DIMACCOUNT
(
 AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,ProfitCostCode
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT DISTINCT
AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,ProfitCostCode
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMPRODUCT] AS
BEGIN

WITH FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)

, PRODUCT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.Dimproduct
)
,TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT AS (
SELECT
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM Product_SK) AS ProductSK
    ,BFP.FinancialProductId AS ProductID
    ,BFP.FinancialProductName AS ProductName
    ,BFPG.ProductGrouping AS ProductGroup
    ,NULL AS ProductDescription
    ,BFPA.FcbsApplicationId AS FcbsApplication
    ,DB.BankSk AS BankSK
    ,Null AS BranchSK
    ,1 AS CurrentIndicator
    ,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
    ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
    ,BFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode 
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
    
FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct BFP
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FINANCIALPRODUCTGROUPING BFPG ON BFP.FINANCIALPRODUCTID = BFPG.FINANCIALPRODUCTID AND BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BFPG.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION BFPA ON BFP.FINANCIALPRODUCTID = BFPA.FINANCIALPRODUCTID AND BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BFPA.FinancialInstitutionId --AND BFPA.[TIMESTAMP] = (SELECT * FROM BNKM.FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION) 
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DB ON BFP.FinancialInstitutionId = DB.BANKID
--WHERE BFPA.[TIMESTAMP] = (SELECT MAX([TIMESTAMP]) FROM BNKM.FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION)

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT FROM TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     ProductID
    ,ProductName
    ,ProductGroup
    ,ProductDescription
    ,FcbsApplication
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    )) HASHROW, ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     ProductID
    ,ProductName
    ,ProductGroup
    ,ProductDescription
    ,FcbsApplication
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    )) HASHROW, ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.Dimproduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.ProductID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA;


--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.Dimproduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT SRC ON SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;



INSERT INTO DW.Dimproduct(
ProductSK
,ProductID
,ProductName
,ProductGroup
,ProductDescription
,FcbsApplication
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode 
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
ProductSK
,SRC.ProductID
,ProductName
,ProductGroup
,ProductDescription
,FcbsApplication
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SRC.SourceSystemCode 
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMPRODUCT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = SRC.ProductID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMACCOUNTPRODUCT] AS
BEGIN

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)
, FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)
,TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct
AS(
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK
,* FROM (
SELECT 
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                    
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND DDA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP')  

UNION ALL

SELECT 
 DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,-1 AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                    
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND DDA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'  
GROUP BY
DDA.AccountSK
,
BCAFP.CustomerAccountId
,DDP.ProductSK
,BCAFP.ProductID
,DDB.BankSK
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode 


UNION ALL

SELECT  DISTINCT
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BTTFP.FinancialProductId) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,NULL AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BTTFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode  --change from dimaccount
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                  
FROM BNKM.TreasuryTrade BTT
LEFT JOIN BNKM.TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct BTTFP ON BTTFP.TradeId = BTT.TradeId AND BTTFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BTT.FinancialInstitutionId AND BTT.SourceSystemCode = BTTFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BTT.SourceSystemCode AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BTT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BTTFP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = BTTFP.SOURCESYSTEMCODE AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BTTFP.FinancialProductId = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BankSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BTT.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode AND DDB.BankSK = DDP.BankSK
WHERE BTTFP.SourceSystemCode <> 'DEP' --FOR SEPARATE DEP FILTER

UNION ALL

--FOR DEP RECORDS FILTER
SELECT 
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                    
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionID = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND BCAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
) A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct;


WITH
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,ProductSK
    ,ProductID
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK                  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,ProductSK
    ,ProductID
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK                  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL  THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'    
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimAccountProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct SRC ON SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK  AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID  AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DimAccountProduct (
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,ProductSK
,ProductID
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm      )              
SELECT
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,ProductSK
,SRC.ProductID
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm  
FROM #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = SRC.ProductID AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')
--Where sourcesystemcode is not null

END
